This is not a claim that every frame of every variant or connected OBS path has been visually approved.

checks.observation: Compared with the supplied 58.70–59.50 second reference sequence: center-out lower metal rails, rising face, stacked first/surname text, raised network badge.
Text and badge withdraw, face lowers, then independent rail halves close inward; empty by 600 ms.
Preview has the same contained logo, name hierarchy and held geometry as live.
Fade style remains a simple opacity entrance with no rail deformation.
Corrected premature ancestor opacity: face closes first, rails remain full width before retracting; cleared by 600 ms.
OUT at 180 ms during IN freezes the partial lower rail, fades from that pose, and does not flash a full face or border.
Full-width optional coach ribbon: center-out rails, contained team mark, one-line name, two support lines. Scorebug suppressed.
Existing scorebug-attached coach layout remains available and attached.
Away timeout ordinal above selected wing; separate remaining-count strip extends from its outer lower edge.
Mirrored home timeout tab/tail with singular 1 TIMEOUT REMAINING; accompanied by main scorebug.
Larger numeric values beside smaller COMP/ATT and YARDS labels, editable context, dark lower stat band; no portrait fixture available.
Spanish broadcast card WLD mark fits fully within the logo cell and clears both text lines.
Name and role/experience render yellow, including nested ordinal text.
Full Dallas Cowboys and Philadelphia Eagles names fit; logos, records and scores remain present; zero overflow flags.
Winning away team logo/name/record/score retained with yellow winner name and score. Only that team next to player stat; network/final label absent.
Equivalent home-winner stat card; correct team shown and opponent portion removed.
League deck enters, current league is removed from the remaining deck, subsequent cards retain their slots.
Pattern transition reviewed from 0 to 1500 ms; mark and text contained.
Team-wall transition reviewed from 0 to 1500 ms; shutters cover stage and settle with contained team mark.
Network-wall transition reviewed from 0 to 1500 ms; brand contained and stage covered.
All seven available highlight paths visibly paint yellow. QB control covers its context heading; QB player name has no forced-yellow control. Referee rechecked with populated text on the final build.

Fixed intrinsic grid sizing in lower-thirds, player/stat cards, lineup, matchup, sponsor pick, team record and related mark cells. Actual image bounds remain within assigned cells; original asset bytes unchanged.
Updated score changes 17 to 20 while full assigned team names, logos and records remain contained. No overflow or broken images.
Review controls no longer remain sticky over the frames on narrow/short panels. Six selected lower-third frames can be scrolled fully into view.

limitations: The 416-case inventory exceeds the manually reviewed default-stage and targeted variant coverage listed here; unsampled variants remain open.
Six-stage default passes use selected timestamps, supplemented by detailed strips for changed animation families; they are not continuous frame-by-frame coverage of every animation.
OBS shared-media delivery, camera permission and live remote browser embedding require a connected output check; isolated review fixtures deliberately do not use the production show or hardware.
Reference matches retain the user WLD brand and uploaded team artwork. No production deployment was performed.
Early audit screenshots show defects subsequently corrected; final-prefixed checks identify the delivered-build verification.
